title: Evidence Erasure Request
description: Body accepted by the evidence erasure endpoint (right-to-erasure workflows).
$comment: Rules the service applies that this document does not express: `before` must additionally parse to a real instant, so a syntactically well-formed but non-existent date such as `2026-02-31` matches the `pattern` here and is still rejected; the accepted value is then normalized to a UTC ISO-8601 instant, so what is stored may not be byte-identical to what was sent. All three filters also accept an explicit `null` (treated as absent), and `decisionIds: []` is treated as absent rather than as an empty selector.
